macros.name: newstatementsp
macros.doc: Define a new statement environment using the `\newstatementsp` command.

macros.name: refcallsp
macros.doc: The \refcallsp{prefix:label} command allows you to display a statement box anywhere in your document.

macros.name: refnamesp
macros.doc: If you provided a specific name for the statement (e.g., “Fermat’s Last Theorem”), you can use the \refnamesp command to reference both the number and the name together.

macros.name: refsp
macros.doc: `\refsp{prefix:label}`: Displays the statement type and its number (e.g., Theorem 1.1). - `\refnamesp{prefix:label}`: Displays the statement type, number, and its specific name (e.g., Theorem 1.1:(Fermat's Last Theorem)).

envs.name: statementsp
envs.doc: You can use the `statementsp` environment for numbered boxes and `statementsp*` for unnumbered boxes.

envs.name: statementsp
envs.doc: You can use the `statementsp` environment for numbered boxes and `statementsp*` for unnumbered boxes.
